Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
2nd August 1916

Sir,
The following is translation of an extract from
the Deutsche Zeitung fur China, 1-8-16.

"A horrible discovery at Chinkiang.
Great excitement prevailed on board the "Tatung"
(Butterfield & Swire) on her arrival at Chinkiang on
Monday morning. From a few parcels and a leather
trunk there emanated a piercing smell. This luggage
had been put on board the ship at Shanghai and was
not claimed by anyone. The Captain handed it over to
a Customs official and it was opened on the same afternoon
in the presence of the Chinese Magistrate. The contents
were the naked, and terribly mutilated bodies of two
Chinese women. One appeared to be of the better class
and the other of the coolie class. Both heads were
missing and the legs of both the bodies were in
separate parcels."

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

警务处。
（侦探股）
1916年8月2日

先生：
兹附上1916年8月1日《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung für China）摘录之译文。

“镇江发现骇人惨案。
周一上午，‘大通’轮（Butterfield & Swire公司所属）抵达镇江时，船上人心惶惶，极度震惊。从几个包裹和一个皮箱中散发出一股刺鼻的气味。这些行李是在上海装船的，但无人认领。船长将其移交给一名海关官员，并于当日下午在中国地方官在场的情况下开箱查验。箱内物品为两具中国女性的赤裸尸体，且遭受严重肢解。其中一人似乎出身较好阶层，另一人则属苦力阶层。两颗头颅均不见踪影，两具尸体的双腿分别装在单独的包裹中。”

您忠实的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察长

警务处总监
